description: This file contains utility functions related to resolving and executing npm-related commands within a Node.js environment, including platform-specific logic for Windows and POSIX systems.

methods.name: resolvePathEnvKey
methods.description: Determines the appropriate environment path key, prioritizing 'PATH' case-insensitively.

methods.name: escapeForCmdExe
methods.description: Escapes command-line arguments for Windows cmd.exe, checking for unsafe characters.

methods.name: buildCmdExeCommandLine
methods.description: Constructs a command line string for Windows cmd.exe, properly escaping arguments.

methods.name: resolveToolchainNpmRunner
methods.description: Resolves the full path to the npm CLI script or executable, depending on platform and available files.
